description: For handyman visit, this completion sign-off form records task sequence, authorized repair boundaries, customer-supplied items, added-work protocol, cleanup, and cost cap. Its supporting evidence includes task-level photos, measurements, parts used, functional checks, inaccessible conditions, and customer decisions.
